newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota, GM venture to invest in paint coating line.
newsitem.headline: Toyota, GM venture to invest in paint coating line.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday that New United Motor Manufacturing Inc (NUMMI), a joint venture between Toyota and General Motors Corp, will invest $140 million to build a new paint coating line.
The new paint coating line, which will utilise advanced robotics, will be completed in January 1999 and will replace an ageing facility built 38 years ago, a Toyota spokesman said.
NUMMI, in Fremont, California, produces Toyota Corolla compact cars, Toyota Tacoma pick-up trucks and GM's Geo Prism, which is modelled on the Corolla.
NUMMI produced 86,900 Corollas in the January to June period, up from 78,300 in the same 1996 period. It also produced 34,000 Geo Prisms, down from 35,600, and 70,400 Tacomas, up from 70,200.
NUMMI is scheduled to start producing remodelled Corollas and Geo Prisms in August of this year.
